summary: Unblocks local catalog and data-class governance validators for the backbone PR by adding conservative global catalog records for existing workspace crates, annotating existing kernel fields, deleting stale legacy allowances, and recording the remote Actions-budget failure mode.
claim_boundary: This changes metadata and comments only. It claims local catalog/data-class validator pass, focused compile pass for touched kernel crates, and PR check-run annotation diagnosis. It does not claim remote GitHub Actions runner execution, branch-protection success, merge, production deployment, live gateway, live database, live collector, or live broker evidence.

facets.F1_simplicity: Catalog records use the existing flat registry shape with conservative preview, unreviewed, source-only posture; kernel changes are line-local data_class comments.
facets.F2_correctness: The records cover workspace crates previously reported missing by catalog validation; data-class comments convert previously untracked kernel fields into annotated fields and stale legacy rows are removed.
facets.F5_quality: The two known local governance blockers from prior closeout are now re-run to passing results instead of remaining as known failures.
facets.F7_security_privacy: No new runtime data flow is introduced. Sensitive DSR/SCIM fields are annotated as sensitive, audit-chain sealing fields as AUDIT/INTERNAL_ONLY, and catalog records avoid unsupported operational data classes in privacy-owned lists.
facets.F10_ci_cd: PR #179 remote checks did not start runner steps because the Actions budget prevented use; this is recorded as an external CI execution blocker and no remote green result is claimed.
facets.F13_reversibility: The change is additive catalog metadata plus comments/legacy-row deletion and can be reverted without altering business behavior.
